evals.prompt: Inspect the attached synthetic list of twelve possible community projects. Rank the strongest directions and give me a cheap first test. If none is ready, say so.
evals.expected_output: Shows every candidate against visible criteria, applies a viability floor, permits a zero-winner result, and gives a bounded first test only for a viable direction.

evals.prompt: Search the current web for what independent educators are struggling with when turning live sessions into reusable resources. Give me links and patterns, and report failed searches or weak coverage.
evals.expected_output: Produces a dated search log and one of four honest scan statuses, cites current underlying sources, separates experience from fact, and does not manufacture a signal or claim monitoring.

evals.prompt: Inspect the attached synthetic research on three membership models. Map the evidence, judge whether it is sufficient, and ask me before recording a final decision.
evals.follow_up_prompt: Choose the strongest supported option if the evidence is sufficient. If it is not, decline and name the smallest missing evidence.
evals.expected_output: Labels source and evidence status, chooses recommend, provisional, or decline pending evidence, pauses at the user gate, and only then creates a final decision record.

evals.prompt: Our weekly content approval process is slow and confusing. Redesign the workflow and show what people, AI, and automation should each own.
evals.expected_output: Maps and diagnoses the recurring workflow, creates a controlled future state and high-level pilot outline, and routes evidence-grade test design to Experiment Designer and Ledger.

evals.prompt: Compare the three fictional facilitators in the attached fixture and prepare a handoff only if someone meets every must-have. Treat every unverified current detail as unknown.
evals.expected_output: Returns qualified, provisional, or no qualified match, labels cost and availability unknowns, and creates a final handoff only for a qualified candidate.

evals.prompt: We think a monthly office hour will improve member retention. Design the cheapest useful test and start an evidence ledger.
evals.expected_output: Precommits prediction, sample, measure, stop rule, and confounders, uses append-only versioned records, preserves raw evidence, and never calls an untested result proof.

evals.prompt: Inspect the attached synthetic talk notes, recommend what package I need for a two-hour pilot, and ask me before producing all the materials.
evals.follow_up_prompt: Create the recommended minimum package. Keep it in draft if a critical decision is missing.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the source, recommends a right-sized deliverable set, waits for selection, and never calls a package run-ready while critical blockers remain.

evals.prompt: Create one control pack from the attached synthetic campaign brief with references, assets, decisions, owners, approvals, risks, and delivery state.
evals.expected_output: Creates a source-of-truth control artifact, preserves proposed, draft, and approved status, records approval evidence, and avoids unauthorized asset generation or external action.

evals.prompt: Review the attached synthetic interview transcript, tell me which reusable outputs are genuinely worth making, and wait for my selection.
evals.follow_up_prompt: Create only the internal decision summary. Do not create a public artifact.
evals.expected_output: Preserves provenance, distinguishes decisions from ideas, records reuse permission and audience, waits for selection, and blocks outward reuse when permission is absent.

evals.prompt: The attached synthetic onboarding method worked twice but is not fully proven. Decide what to test next before it becomes a reusable offer.
evals.expected_output: Labels the evidence as promising, compares delivery form separately from access and economics, and creates a validation test without presenting the method as proven.
